correctness.rationale: Angular separation makes H(e_n) orthogonal for distinct n, so singular values are the decreasing rearrangement of d_n. For U_n~Beta(n+1,alpha+1), exact projection yields d_n²=E[U_n Y_n²]-n/(n+alpha+1)(E Y_n)² with Y_n=1+(log(e/(1-U_n)))^{-a}; difference from Var(Y_n) is O_alpha(1/n). Set X_n=n(1-U_n), L=1+log n; logarithmic moments converge, Var(log X_n)->psi_1(alpha+1) and uniformly controlled fourth moments plus exponential endpoint tails justify L^{a+1}(Y_n-constant)-> a log X in L². Rearrangement then gives exact constant, compactness and divergence of all Schatten p-series. Independently computed gamma-proxy variance/leading coefficient ratios for alpha=0,1,-0.5 and a=1,0.5,1.5 at n=10^4,10^6 (slow approach consistent with inverse-log remainders); the gamma proxy is not a direct beta certification and does not prove the limit.
residual_risks: Gamma-proxy numerical trend has slow logarithmic convergence and is not a direct finite-n test of beta d_n.
